purpose: Loro merge-rules pattern half (Marathon R12 lane BB; ideas board line 185, Round 10 RB research, Tier A). PATTERN ONLY: the Loro CRDT family's merge rules restated in our own words as data + machinery in scripts/wiki_loro_merge.py, for index/outline STATE values. This does NOT change the wiki's write topology: git remains the only sync/write layer for wiki content, no page or index file is read or written by the tool, and no CRDT library is imported or vendored.
rules: lww-map: per key, the entry with the greater (counter, actor) stamp wins; a winning tombstone (deleted=true) removes the key from the live view but stays in the merged state

moveable-tree: moves from both sides are unioned and replayed in (counter, actor) order over the base parents; a move that would create a cycle, or names a missing node or parent, loses and the node keeps its prior parent

shallow-snapshot: roots plus per-node parent / child_count / subtree_hash plus live map keys plus a state hash; nested child lists and map values are NOT inlined, so states compare cheaply before any full merge
seed_note: Seeded EMPTY-BUT-VALID: the state holds no nodes, moves or map entries. No live index or outline was converted into this shape at build time — populating it from a real outline is operational use, a separate act from this build.
